build_copy_changes: Disable automatic SE_EXPR_PLUGINS discovery; explicit host function registration remains available
Disable environment-selected expression debugging; diagnostics are explicitly owned by the host
Invoke the host thread-local instruction budget before each interpreter instruction
Reset the interpreter local-function call stack at evaluation entry to recover from cancellation
Use standard C++17 snprintf and log2 on Windows
Delete the Windows critical section through its concrete type
Expose the standard C++17 cbrt, asinh, acosh, atanh and trunc functions on every platform
Keep the default evaluation backend interpreter-based and independent of process environment
Isolate SDK graph resolution temporary state and evaluate selected dependencies in topological order
Adapt the optional JIT emitter to LLVM 14 typed builder and fixed-vector APIs
Insert no-throw JIT evaluation budget checks and capture callback exceptions for native reporting
Use bounded native string concatenation with terminator allocation in the optional JIT backend
